title: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter as Nato jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
summary_full: Danish prime minister Mette Frederiksen condemns ‘reckless action from Russia towards Denmark’s military’A Russian warship has fired two emergency flares at a Danish helicopter in the Baltic Sea, and Nato fighter jets have shot down a drone over Lithuania, in the latest security incidents on the alliance’s eastern flank linked to Russia’s war against Ukraine.Poland also scrambled fighter jets “due to the activity of Russian jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicles conducting strikes on Ukrainian territory”, a day after retrieving a suspected Russian drone adrift in its waters.
